en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a leafy park scene with a curving path that forks into two directions, bordered by large trees and landscaped flower beds. On the left edge is part of a brick building covered in climbing plants. The caption at the bottom identifies the place as a scene from Hasselbacken in Uddevalla, and there is a small printer's or publisher's mark in an oval at the lower right.
